title: Watch the trailer for 'Perfect Liars,' the adaptation of the hit novel coming to Prime Video November 20
summary: This thriller set in an elite university is based on author Alex Mírez's captivating Wattpad novel.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- Perfect Liars


premieres exclusively on Prime Video on November 20 worldwide.


- The film is based on Alex Mírez's Wattpad novel that has more than 140 million reads.


- The thriller is directed by Jesús Colmenar, known for


Money Heist


. Watch the teaser trailer above.


---


[Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/prime-video) has unveiled the teaser trailer for


Perfect Liars


, a thriller of revenge, secrets, and betrayal set in an elite university.


The Spanish Original film is based on author


[Alex Mírez's novel](https://www.wattpad.com/story/136017693-perfectos-mentirosos-%C2%A9-completa%E2%9C%94%EF%B8%8F) , a Wattpad sensation which has captivated readers worldwide with over 140 million reads.


Here's everything you need to know about the upcoming movie which will release on November 20 on Prime Video.


## What is ‘Perfect Liars’ about?


Welcome to Tagus, where power, privilege, and deadly secrets hide behind perfect facades.


Jude Derry arrives at this exclusive university with a hidden mission: to infiltrate the circle of the Cash brothers and uncover the truth about her brother's death. The three heirs to the family empire dominate Tagus with a magnetism that no one can resist. There’s Aegan, the charismatic and calculating firstborn, Adrik, the enigmatic and mysterious middle brother, and Aleixandre, the rebellious and unpredictable youngest.


[How to watch ‘Drawn Together,’ the adaptation of ‘Marfil’ by Mercedes Ron, streaming now on Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/marfil-drawn-together-prime-video)


Starring Ester Expósito and Hugo Diego García, the first part of the 'Enfrentados' duology is streaming exclusively on Prime Video.


What begins as personal revenge transforms into a dangerous triangle of seduction, forbidden attraction, and lies when Jude becomes entangled in the complex family dynamics of the Cashes.


With each clue she uncovers, she draws closer to a truth that could not only destroy the powerful family—but also reveal secrets that perhaps she herself is not prepared to face.


## Who is in the ‘Perfect Liars’ cast?


The film stars:


- Irene Balmes (


The Messiah


) as Jude Derry


- Gleb Abrosimov (


Elite


) as Aegan Cash


- Pau Simon (


The Billionaire’s Bunker


) as Adrik Cash


- Pablo Scapigliati (


El bus de la vida


) as Aleixandre Cash


- Asier Etxeandia (


[Pain and Glory](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0HB1ZLJ1G?pageTypeId=B0HB2PQG57&ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_sr62ef6f_1_1_1&qid=1789573770810&pageTypeIdSource=ASIN&sr=1-1) ) as Adrien Cash


- Irene Ferreiro (


Skam España


) as Artie


## When is the ‘Perfect Liars’ release date?


Perfect Liars


will release exclusively on Prime Video on November 20 in more than 240 countries and territories worldwide.


Prime Video is included with an


[Amazon Prime membership](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/how-to-sign-up-for-a-prime-membership) , which costs $14.99 monthly or $139 annually in the U.S. Discounted memberships are also available for


[young adults](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-for-young-adults) and


[qualifying government assistance recipients](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-access-discounted-membership) at 50% off. Check your local Amazon website for information on Prime membership pricing in your region.


Not a member yet? Start a


[30-day free trial](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-free-trial) today.


## Who made 'Perfect Liars'?


The film is written and directed by Jesús Colmenar (


Money Heist


) with Ángela Armero (


If I Were a Rich Man


) as co-writer, based on the books by Alex Mírez.


It is produced by Federation Spain with Juan Solá (


[Retribution](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0C8XYK41H?qid=1789573613358&pageTypeId=B0C8Y8GPVD&ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_sr9f90f0_9_1_7&sr=1-7&pageTypeIdSource=ASIN) ) and Mark Albela (


[Awareness](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/B0B6JSQQPK?qid=1789573613358&pageTypeId=B0B6JRWPPL&pageTypeIdSource=ASIN&sr=1-1&ref_=atv_sr_fle_c_sr9f90f0_1_1_1) ) as producers, and WEBTOON Productions with David Madden, Mar Vila Barcelo, and Wattpad President Aron Levitz as consulting producers.
